items.q: Which part of a neuron receives impulses from other neurons?
items.qAf: Watter deel van ’n neurone ontvang impulse van ander neurone?
items.explain: Dendrites carry impulses towards the cell body from other neurons.
items.explainAf: Dendriete dra impulse na die sel-liggaam toe vanaf ander neurone.

items.q: What is the function of the myelin sheath?
items.qAf: Wat is die funksie van die mieliënskede?
options: It speeds up the conduction of impulses
optionsAf: It speeds up the conduction of impulses
items.explain: Myelin insulates the axon, so the impulse jumps between nodes and travels faster.
items.explainAf: Mieliën isoleer die akson, sodat die impuls tussen nodusse spring en vinniger beweeg.

items.q: Which order describes a reflex arc?
options: Receptor, sensory neurone, relay neurone, motor neurone, effector
Effector, motor neurone, relay neurone, sensory neurone, receptor
optionsAf: Receptor, sensory neurone, relay neurone, motor neurone, effector
Effector, motor neurone, relay neurone, sensory neurone, receptor
items.explain: The impulse travels from the receptor through the spinal cord to the effector without passing the brain.
items.explainAf: Die impuls beweeg van die reseptor deur die ruggraatmurg na die effektor sonder om die brein te bereik.

items.q: When the eye accommodates for near vision, what happens to the lens?
items.qAf: Wanneer die oog vir naby sig akkommodeer, wat gebeur met die lens?
options: It becomes more convex as the ciliary muscles contract
It becomes flatter as the ciliary muscles relax
It moves to the back of the eye
optionsAf: It becomes more convex as the ciliary muscles contract
It becomes flatter as the ciliary muscles relax
It moves to the back of the eye
items.explain: Ciliary muscles contract, the suspensory ligaments slacken and the lens becomes thicker and more convex.
items.explainAf: Silierspiere trek saam, die suspensoriese ligamente slap en die lens word dikker en meer bol.

items.q: Which photoreceptors are responsible for colour vision in bright light?
items.qAf: Watter fotoreseptore is verantwoordelik vir kleurvisie in helder lig?
items.explain: Cones function in bright light and detect different colours; rods work in dim light.
items.explainAf: Kegels werk in helder lig en onderskei kleure; staafies werk in swak lig.

items.q: Which structure in the inner ear detects rotational movement of the head?
items.qAf: Watter struktuur in die binneoor onderskei rotasiebeweging van die kop?
items.explain: The semicircular canals contain fluid and hair cells that detect rotation, which helps with balance.
items.explainAf: Die semisirkelvormige kanale bevat vloeistof en haarselle wat rotasie onderskei, wat balans help.
